metaDescription: Order custom sublimation personal protection equipment for full-color branding. Perfect for safety managers at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows you to add vibrant, full-color logos and graphics to personal protection equipment without compromising safety. Unlike standard screen printing, sublimation dyes bond with the fabric, producing a soft, breathable finish that won't crack or peel. This makes sublimation PPE ideal for trade shows, corporate uniforms, or promotional giveaways where both brand visibility and worker comfort matter. Choose from polyester-based hard hats, safety vests, or face masks for a professional look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation personal protection equipment with full-color logo on a safety vest
